name: The Harbinger of the Deep
storyline:
Life has accelerated due to technology as we know it. Heavenly skyscrapers, advanced transportation, automated livelihoods, it was an amazing feat of engineering. But it had its sacrifices, nature destroyed, habitats disrupted. Nature decided it had enough and fought back. The oceans flooded the entire world and destroying all of the progress. From its remains and its survivors, a new Sea floated to its surface and came to be. But with feral instincts, infights happened, corruption prospered, and walls and divisions rose up.

That's where you come in. You're given the power to decide the fate of the Sea. Befriend and fix the frustrations? Or destroy and create a clean slate?
summary: Destroy the frustrations of other Beings and befriend them, or ignore them and slay them all instead! Shoot your actions and decide the fate of this submerged world in The Harbinger of the Deep!
